title: Three Summers and One Short Crate
subtitle: 植物农业 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）
meta: 主题语境：植物农业（人与自然·自然生态·植物与农业）　|　核心词汇：wheat　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 wheat 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1975 the grower ① grew the wheat that no buyer in the greenhouse would have measured, and he said the growing was the whole of the summer. The ② wheat, meaning the grain itself and not the crate, ran three summers and stayed unmeasured in the book; wheat, he said, is the only thing in a greenhouse that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ sort of wheat in that greenhouse had the same short crate beside it, and the ④ wheat at the far shelf, meaning the bundle they kept for the children to tie and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. Wheat, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the grower said the measuring is the part that fills three summers.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the wheat was the whole of the matter, meaning the harvest and not the grain. The ⑥ wheat, meaning the harvest and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; wheat, he said, is either something you grow or the only word that means both grain and a harvest. He said the harvest is the part they remember.

By 1980 the ⑦ wheat had become a line in a ledger, and the ledger had become an argument about the short crate. The ⑧ wheat of the whole thing, the grower wrote in August, was one greenhouse and three summers of measuring; wheat, he said, is either the bundle at the far shelf or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ wheat I remember is the wheat measured in the ledger, which closed in 1982 and is still measured as the quietest in the greenhouse. ⑩ Wheat, my mother said in 1984, is the only thing that improves by being measured; all wheat, she said, is a harvest that has agreed to look like grain. She said the harvest was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 小麦（指大棚里每一种旁边的那一种）
B. n. 小麦（指那片小麦本身，与浅浅的木箱相对）
C. 固定搭配：grow the wheat 种这一片小麦
D. n. 小麦（指留给孩子们捆的那一捆）
E. n. 小麦之事（抽象总称，指一处大棚的小麦之事）
F. n. 小麦（指收成账里写到、被测量的那一片）
G. n. 小麦、收成（指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 收成（抽象总称，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: grow the wheat 意为“种这一片小麦”，1975 年那位种植户把大棚里没有一位收购人肯测量的一片小麦做了一遍。
wheat 意为“小麦”，指那片小麦本身而不是浅浅的木箱，它经过了三个夏天而在簿子上没有被测量。
wheat 意为“小麦”，指大棚里每一种旁边的那一种，每一种旁边都有同一只浅浅的木箱。
wheat 意为“小麦”，指最远那层架位的留给孩子们捆的那一捆，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
wheat 意为“小麦、收成”，指一件事里人人都收却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这片收成就是那件事的全部。
wheat 意为“收成”，指人人都收却无人提起的那样东西而不是那片小麦，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
wheat 意为“小麦”，指收成账里写到、被测量的那一片，到 1980 年这一片成了收成账里的一行。
wheat 意为“小麦之事”，种植户八月写道，整件事的小麦之事是一处大棚和三个夏天的测量。
wheat 意为“小麦”，我记得的是收成账里测量过的那一片，1982 年收完了，至今仍被说成大棚里最安静的一片。
wheat 为抽象总称，母亲 1984 年说，小麦是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的小麦。
